data.title: 红莲 · 晴空草甸的十指相扣
data.description: 微风吹拂的青草坡上，草帽放在一旁充当遮阳。两人并肩躺在盛开野花的绿茵中看白云流转，十指紧密相扣，雪白马尾在微风中轻抚你的手臂，岁月安好。
data.location: sunlit grassy meadow with blooming wildflowers
data.action: lying side by side on lush grass, woven sedge hat resting beside head, interlocking fingers, white ponytail spread on greenery, looking up at drifting clouds
data.lighting: bright cheerful sunlit day with gentle flower dappled light
data.mood: idyllic serenity, timeless peaceful love, gentle summer warmth
data.promptProse: Lying side by side in a wildflower meadow, Scarlet holds hands with interlocked fingers while smiling up at the blue summer sky.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet holding hands while resting on a grassy meadow under the sunny sky.
